newsitem.title: LATVIA: C.BANK FOREIGN ASSETS DOWN 0.4 PCT IN APR.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK FOREIGN ASSETS DOWN 0.4 PCT IN APR.

text.p: The gold and foreign currency assets of the Latvian central bank slipped 0.4 percent in April to 503.617 million lats, the bank said on Friday.
It said that the reduction in foreign assets was due to the continued repayment of IMF loans and commercial banks pulling some of their foreign funds from their accounts in the central bank.
The amount of lats in circulation grew 0.2 percent to 292.344 million lats in April, the bank added.
